benchmark.task_contract: Implement solve(problem, tools). The problem exposes task_id, noisy observations as a list of trajectories of state vectors, positive dt, dimension, requirements and tool_api. It may include numerical_budget supplied by the host. It exposes no true dynamics, family labels or hidden forecasts. Return {'model': {'terms': ['1', 'x0', 'sin(x0)', ...], 'coefficients': [[...], ...]}, with one finite coefficient row per state dimension and one coefficient per term; dx_j/dt is the sum of coefficient[j][k] times term[k]. Supported expressions are documented in tool_api. Optional hypotheses, experiments and limitations document research but do not award scores. The host independently integrates the model from unseen initial conditions. Use only visible observations for fitting and internal validation. Numerical divergence is measured failure; resource-unavailable evaluation is missing.
benchmark.title: Scientific discovery: dynamical systems
benchmark.tool_api:
Define solve(problem, tools), returning {'model':model,'hypotheses':list,'experiments':list,'limitations':list}.
problem: opaque task_id, observations=list of trajectories (trajectory=list of state vectors), dt, dimension, question, requirements. Observations contain measurement noise; no true field or test trajectory is supplied.
model={'terms':['1','x0','x1','x0*x1','sin(x0)',...], 'coefficients':[[coefficient for each term] for each state dimension]}; dx[j]/dt=sum(coefficients[j][k]*terms[k]). Expressions support x0..x5, t, finite constants, + - * / ** (literal exponent <=6), sin cos tanh exp sqrt log abs. Max 64 terms. Return finite JSON only.
tools.smooth(states, window=9, degree=3) -> smoothed states; window 0 disables smoothing.
tools.differentiate(states,dt,window=9,degree=3) -> derivative vectors from observations only.
tools.feature_matrix(states,terms,times=None) -> numeric design matrix.
tools.linear_fit(features,targets,ridge=1e-6,threshold=0.01,iterations=8) -> coefficients[state][term], training_rmse, complexity, work_units. Threshold is normalized contribution relative to target standard deviation.
tools.fit_model(observations,dt,terms,window=9,degree=3,ridge=1e-6,threshold=0.01,weak_window=0) -> model,training_rmse,complexity,work_units. weak_window>=2 fits integral collocation instead of derivatives; this is an integral regression primitive, not a complete WSINDy implementation.
tools.integrate(model,initial,dt,steps,substeps=2,start_time=0.0) -> trajectory including initial state; divergent predictions raise errors, never clip.
tools.validate(model,observations,dt,fraction=0.65) -> score,nrmse,stable,complexity,work_units on the visible trajectory suffix. Keep these trajectories out of fitting for independent observation validation! This is not the private evaluator.
tools.receipts() -> numerical-call receipts. Nested work_units overlap; use cumulative_work_units/runner total, never sum nested receipts.
You may implement functions, algorithms, continuous parameter search, new expression libraries, resampling, explicit validation splits and control flow in source. Tool budgets accumulate across calls and tasks. Public self-reported experiment text does not establish independent evidence; execution receipts and the trusted grader do.

Define solve(problem, tools), returning {'model':model,'hypotheses':list,'experiments':list,'limitations':list}.

It exposes no true dynamics, family labels or hidden forecasts. Return {'model': {'terms': ['1', 'x0', 'sin(x0)', ...], 'coefficients': [[...], ...]}, with one finite coefficient row per state dimension and one coefficient per term; dx_j/dt is the sum of coefficient[j][k] times term[k]. Supported expressions are documented in tool_api. Optional hypotheses, experiments and limitations document research but do not award scores. The host independently integrates the model from unseen initial conditions. Use only visible observations for fitting and internal validation. benchmark.title: Scientific discovery: dynamical systems
benchmark.tool_api:
Define solve(problem, tools), returning {'model':model,'hypotheses':list,'experiments':list,'limitations':list}.
problem: opaque task_id, observations=list of trajectories (trajectory=list of state vectors), dt, dimension, question, requirements. Observations contain measurement noise; no true field or test trajectory is supplied.
model={'terms':['1','x0','x1','x0*x1','sin(x0)',...], 'coefficients':[[coefficient for each term] for each state dimension]}; dx[j]/dt=sum(coefficients[j][k]*terms[k]). Expressions support x0..x5, t, finite constants, + - * / ** (literal exponent <=6), sin cos tanh exp sqrt log abs. Max 64 terms. Return finite JSON only.
tools.smooth(states, window=9, degree=3) -> smoothed states; window 0 disables smoothing.
tools.differentiate(states,dt,window=9,degree=3) -> derivative vectors from observations only.
tools.feature_matrix(states,terms,times=None) -> numeric design matrix.
tools.linear_fit(features,targets,ridge=1e-6,threshold=0.01,iterations=8) -> coefficients[state][term], training_rmse, complexity, work_units. Threshold is normalized contribution relative to target standard deviation.
tools.fit_model(observations,dt,terms,window=9,degree=3,ridge=1e-6,threshold=0.01,weak_window=0) -> model,training_rmse,complexity,work_units. weak_window>=2 fits integral collocation instead of derivatives; this is an integral regression primitive, not a complete WSINDy implementation.
tools.integrate(model,initial,dt,steps,substeps=2,start_time=0.0) -> trajectory including initial state; divergent predictions raise errors, never clip.
tools.validate(model,observations,dt,fraction=0.65) -> score,nrmse,stable,complexity,work_units on the visible trajectory suffix. Keep these trajectories out of fitting for independent observation validation! This is not the private evaluator.
tools.receipts() -> numerical-call receipts. Nested work_units overlap; use cumulative_work_units/runner total, never sum nested receipts.
You may implement functions, algorithms, continuous parameter search, new expression libraries, resampling, explicit validation splits and control flow in source. Tool budgets accumulate across calls and tasks. Public self-reported experiment text does not establish independent evidence; execution receipts and the trusted grader do.

def improve(context, broker):
    # Direct meta-mechanism research branch: always test a meta.py candidate when
    # probe_improver capability is true and meta.py is editable, regardless of triggers.
    # This ensures meta-level experimentation occurs, not just triggered repair.
    if context.get('capabilities', {}).get('probe_improver') and 'meta.py' in context.get('editable_components', []):
        return meta_mechanism_exploration(context, broker)
    # Fallback to ordinary task improvement
    return research_cycle(context, broker)

def meta_mechanism_exploration(context, broker):
    """
    Design and test a meta.py candidate that restructures improve() to use
    budget-aware adaptive role allocation and a diagnostic-first design phase.
    """
    parent = context.get('parent', {})
    budget = context.get('budget', {})
    calls, tokens = budget.get('remaining_calls', 0), budget.get('remaining_completion_tokens', 0)
    research = {'branch': 'meta_mechanism_exploration', 'limitation': 'Unverified development-only meta probe.'}
    
    # Step 1: Request a meta.py design that implements adaptive budget allocation
    design_payload = {
        'phase': 'meta_mechanism_research',
        'domain': context.get('domain', {}),
        'task_contract': context.get('task_contract', {}),
        'tool_api': context.get('tool_api', ''),
        'parent': parent,
        'development': context.get('development', {}),
        'budget': budget,
        'instruction': (
            'Return a complete meta.py that implements improve(context,broker) with these changes: '
            '(1) Before calling parallel analysts, inspect context.development.tasks for per-task status and work_units. '
            '(2) Skip the mechanism_researcher role if all tasks are stable (nrmse<0.01) and budget is tight; '
            'use that token budget for a second source_designer iteration instead. '
            '(3) Always run a probe_improver when capability is true, but use the actual probe feedback to decide '
            'whether to attempt a repair: only repair if probe shows negative development_gain. '
            '(4) In research_cycle, pass the full parent development record (including per-task failures) to the '
            'source_designer payload. Return exactly one candidate meta.py.'
        )
    }
    design = broker.ask('main', 'Implement an adaptive meta.py with budget-aware role selection and probe-guided repair.', design_payload, max_tokens=6000)
    
    # Step 2: Validate the proposal
    candidate, check = inspect_source_proposal(design, parent.get('files', {}), ['meta.py'])
    if check['issues']:
        research['status'] = 'invalid_design'
        research['issues'] = check['issues']
        return {'candidates': [], 'research': research}
    
    # Step 3: Run development experiment
    trial = run_development(candidate, broker, 'Test adaptive meta.py with probe-guided repair')
    research['trial'] = trial
    issues = experiment_issues(trial, context.get('development', {}), budget)
    
    # Step 4: Attempt repair if needed and budget allows
    if issues and calls >= 16 and tokens >= 70000:
        repair_payload = design_payload.copy()
        repair_payload.update({
            'phase': 'targeted_source_repair',
            'previous_candidate': candidate,
            'repair_triggers': issues,
            'actual_development_report': trial,
            'remaining_repair_calls': 1
        })
        repaired = broker.ask('main', 'Repair the meta.py candidate based on actual development failures.', repair_payload, max_tokens=6000)
        revised, revised_check = inspect_source_proposal(repaired, parent.get('files', {}), ['meta.py'])
        if not revised_check['issues'] and not revision_difference(revised, candidate).get('comments_only_or_identical'):
            candidate = revised
            research['repair_used'] = True
    
    return {'candidates': [candidate], 'research': research}

def research_cycle(context, broker):
    roles = context.get("roles", {})
    parent = context.get("parent", {})
    query = context.get("literature_query", "dynamical systems sparse identification")
    literature = broker.search(query)
    broker.log("literature", literature)
    evidence_payload = {
        "question": context.get("question", "Discover reproducible scientific dynamics"),
        "development": context.get("development", {}),
        "failures": context.get("failures", []),
        "archive": context.get("archive", []),
        "parent": {"id": parent.get("id"), "generation": parent.get("generation"),
                   "files": parent.get("files", {}), "component_digests": parent.get("component_digests", {})},
        "tool_api": context.get("tool_api", ""),
        "editable_components": context.get("editable_components", ["task.py", "meta.py", "workflow.py", "roles.json"]),
        "literature": literature,
        "budget": context.get("budget", {})
    }
    analyses = broker.parallel([
        {"role": "mechanism_researcher", "prompt": roles.get("mechanism_researcher", "Analyze scientific and software failure mechanisms."),
         "payload": evidence_payload, "max_tokens": 2200},
        {"role": "experimental_critic", "prompt": roles.get("experimental_critic", "Design experiments that could disprove the proposed mechanisms."),
         "payload": evidence_payload, "max_tokens": 2200}
    ])
    broker.log("hypotheses", analyses)
    design_payload = {
        "question": evidence_payload["question"],
        "parent": evidence_payload["parent"],
        "tool_api": evidence_payload["tool_api"],
        "editable_components": evidence_payload["editable_components"],
        "development": evidence_payload["development"],
        "archive": evidence_payload["archive"],
        "analyses": analyses, "literature": literature,
        "runtime_contract": context.get("runtime_contract", ""),
        "budget": evidence_payload["budget"]
    }
    design = broker.ask("main", roles.get("source_designer", "Return candidate source replacements and research rationale."),
                        design_payload, max_tokens=6000)
    candidates = design.get("candidates", [])
    trials = []
    if candidates:
        first = candidates[0]
        try:
            trial = broker.experiment(first.get("files", {}), "Test the first proposed scientific mechanism on development observations")
        except Exception as failure:
            trial = {"status": "failed", "error": str(failure),
                     "limitation": "The development experiment failed; this candidate has no successful measurement."}
        trials.append(trial)
        broker.log("experiment", trial)
    return {"candidates": candidates, "research": {
        "literature": literature, "hypotheses": analyses,
        "design": design.get("research", {}), "development_experiments": trials,
        "limitation": "Development trials are not held-out evidence. Proposed gains require independent evaluation."
    }}

benchmark.title: Scientific discovery: dynamical systems
benchmark.tool_api:
Define solve(problem, tools), returning {'model':model,'hypotheses':list,'experiments':list,'limitations':list}.
problem: opaque task_id, observations=list of trajectories (trajectory=list of state vectors), dt, dimension, question, requirements. Observations contain measurement noise; no true field or test trajectory is supplied.
model={'terms':['1','x0','x1','x0*x1','sin(x0)',...], 'coefficients':[[coefficient for each term] for each state dimension]}; dx[j]/dt=sum(coefficients[j][k]*terms[k]). Expressions support x0..x5, t, finite constants, + - * / ** (literal exponent <=6), sin cos tanh exp sqrt log abs. Max 64 terms. Return finite JSON only.
tools.smooth(states, window=9, degree=3) -> smoothed states; window 0 disables smoothing.
tools.differentiate(states,dt,window=9,degree=3) -> derivative vectors from observations only.
tools.feature_matrix(states,terms,times=None) -> numeric design matrix.
tools.linear_fit(features,targets,ridge=1e-6,threshold=0.01,iterations=8) -> coefficients[state][term], training_rmse, complexity, work_units. Threshold is normalized contribution relative to target standard deviation.
tools.fit_model(observations,dt,terms,window=9,degree=3,ridge=1e-6,threshold=0.01,weak_window=0) -> model,training_rmse,complexity,work_units. weak_window>=2 fits integral collocation instead of derivatives; this is an integral regression primitive, not a complete WSINDy implementation.
tools.integrate(model,initial,dt,steps,substeps=2,start_time=0.0) -> trajectory including initial state; divergent predictions raise errors, never clip.
tools.validate(model,observations,dt,fraction=0.65) -> score,nrmse,stable,complexity,work_units on the visible trajectory suffix. Keep these trajectories out of fitting for independent observation validation! This is not the private evaluator.
tools.receipts() -> numerical-call receipts. Nested work_units overlap; use cumulative_work_units/runner total, never sum nested receipts.
